_note: RAG corpus for the ToothFairy advisory layer. Categories: 'diagnosis' (impact/symptoms/severity/pathogenesis/AI-limits), 'treatment' (clinical management guidelines), 'context' (Indonesian epidemiology & policy). The diagnosis agent retrieves over {diagnosis, context}; the recommendation agent (later) adds {treatment}. `function` is the dentist's stated inference role for the LLM.

documents.title: Impact of untreated dental caries on the daily activities of children
documents.function: Probabilitas lesi karies tidak terawat memicu gangguan fungsional (makan/mengunyah) dan psikologis (tidur, kecemasan) pada anak; memprediksi gejala harian dari klasifikasi ICDAS.

documents.title: Relation between Consequences of Untreated Dental Caries (Pufa Index) and Oral Health Related Quality of Life in 4 to 6 Years Old Children
documents.function: Pedoman skoring PUFA/pufa (Pulpa terekspos, Ulserasi, Fistula, Abses); kemungkinan lesi D6 berevolusi menjadi abses purulen atau ulkus trauma yang merusak OHRQoL.

documents.title: Dental Caries and the Erosive Tooth Wear Status of 12-Year-Old Children in Jakarta, Indonesia
documents.function: Konteks epidemiologis demografi Indonesia; menghubungkan karies multipel dengan faktor risiko deterministik (pendidikan orang tua rendah, konsumsi minuman manis).

documents.title: Is oral health-related quality of life of preschool children affected by the severity of early childhood caries?
documents.function: Validasi metrik ECOHIS; korelasi linier keparahan lesi (D5-D6) terhadap stres emosional keluarga dan performa belajar anak.

documents.title: Association between Early Childhood Caries and Quality of Life: Early Childhood Oral Health Impact Scale and Pufa Index
documents.function: Perburukan kualitas hidup drastis saat skor pufa bergeser 0 -> >0; urgensi intervensi kuratif pada gigi dengan lesi mendekati pulpa sebelum infeksi apikal terbuka.

documents.title: The severity of untreated caries in the deciduous and permanent teeth among children aged 6-12 years using PUFA and pufa index: a cross-sectional study
documents.function: Membedakan patogenesis gigi desidui (FDI 51-85) vs permanen (FDI 11-48); email gigi susu lebih tipis -> progresi D2->D6 jauh lebih cepat.

documents.title: The Relationship between Cariogenic Food Consumption and Tooth Brushing Habits to Dental Caries in 4th, 5th and 6th Grade Students
documents.function: Probabilitas empiris (risiko karies meningkat hingga 11,6x akibat higienitas buruk + diet kariogenik); laporan personalisasi evaluasi gaya hidup.

documents.title: Clinical Consequences of Dental Caries, Parents' Perception of Child's Oral Health and Attitudes towards Dental Visits
documents.function: Panduan narasi komunikasi klinis; argumen bahwa karies gigi susu memicu maloklusi permanen dan infeksi benih gigi di bawahnya.

documents.title: Examination of new clinical dental caries in school children using real intra oral photos with artificial intelligence model YOLO-V8x
documents.function: Wawasan presisi & batas recall algoritma deteksi karies intraoral (Sanity Check); konfirmasi taktil area abu-abu (pit & fissure tertutup debris).

documents.title: PNPK Tata Laksana Karies Gigi (Kemenkes RI, 2025)
documents.function: Kebijakan tertinggi tata laksana klinis Indonesia: pendekatan preventif, remineralisasi (kalsium fosfat, fluor), klasifikasi teknik restoratif.

documents.title: CariesCare International Practice Guide (Martignon et al., 2019)
documents.function: Siklus 4D ICCMS; pohon keputusan menyelaraskan skor ICDAS dengan NOC (fluoride varnish) atau TPOC.

documents.title: The ICCMS: An Example of a Caries Management Pathway (Ismail et al., 2015)
documents.function: Tinjauan filosofis/ilmiah pentingnya manajemen risiko dan penilaian aktivitas lesi sebelum pengeboran mekanis.

documents.title: AAPD Best Practices: Caries-Risk Assessment and Management (2022)
documents.function: Penilaian risiko karies pediatrik AAPD; menimbang faktor protektif vs indikator biologis patologis untuk periode peninjauan ulang.

documents.title: AAPD Policy on ECC Classifications, Consequences, and Preventive Strategies
documents.function: Kerangka pencegahan gaya hidup: protokol sikat gigi, manajemen laktasi/susu botol, pembatasan jus buah prasekolah.

documents.title: AAPD Clinical Practice Guideline on Silver Diamine Fluoride (Crystal et al., 2017)
documents.function: Ulasan GRADE efikasi SDF 38% menghentikan karies koronal gigi primer; jawaban ilmiah efek sistemik/efikasi.

documents.title: Chairside Guide: SDF in the Management of Dental Caries Lesions (AAPD)
documents.function: Protokol step-by-step aplikasi SDF pada lesi kavitasi aktif; isolasi gingiva dan parameter keamanan.

documents.title: FDI World Dental Federation: Carious Lesions & First Restorative Treatment
documents.function: Minimal Intervention Dentistry (FDI); pergerakan dari restorasi amalgam invasif ke restorasi terikat hibrida.

documents.title: FDI Policy Statement on Silver Diamine Fluoride (2025)
documents.function: Justifikasi SDF sebagai intervensi non-restoratif berbiaya efektif untuk fasilitas minim (aerosol-free).

documents.title: PNPK Penyakit Jaringan Pulpa dan Periradikuler (Kemenkes RI, 2024)
documents.function: Protokol lanjutan bila kerusakan ICDAS 6 (infeksi menyebar ke pulpa); intervensi saluran akar pediatrik berdasarkan klasifikasi radiografis periapikal.

documents.title: Prevalence of dental caries among children in Indonesia: A systematic review and meta-analysis of observational studies
documents.function: Prevalensi karies anak Indonesia (meta-analisis); baseline epidemiologis untuk menempatkan temuan pasien dalam konteks populasi.

documents.title: Understanding root caries risk in Indonesian adults: evidence from a nationwide survey
documents.function: Faktor risiko karies akar pada dewasa Indonesia; konteks risiko servikal/akar (relevan untuk temuan panoramik).

documents.title: Early Childhood Caries in Indonesia (Policy Brief, Frontiers in Public Health 2019)
documents.function: Policy brief ECC Indonesia; determinan sosial dan beban karies dini pada anak sebagai konteks faktor risiko.

documents.title: Oral health status and system in Indonesia: a review
documents.function: Status & sistem kesehatan gigi Indonesia; konteks akses layanan dan tantangan sistem yang membentuk perjalanan penyakit.
